title: Wire or delete dead MergeException and OutboxDeadLetterException — neither is ever thrown in lib/
rule: Dead-code/lens-pass sweep (digest 'Everything' applicability) + Evans ubiquitous-language (doc must match reality); AG-6-adjacent speculative generality

evidence.quote: Callers that catch [MergeException] should record the event via crisis
thrown the item should be moved to a dead-letter queue and crisis telemetry

why: Both classes' own doc comments assert they are 'Thrown when...' a specific failure occurs and that catching them triggers crisis telemetry / user-facing recovery. Exhaustive grep of lib/ for 'MergeException(' and 'OutboxDeadLetterException(' matches only their own constructor declarations — zero throw sites exist anywhere in production code (MergeException's only other reference in the whole repo is a widget test that hand-constructs it to exercise AppErrorView's generic category). The behaviors the docs promise ARE implemented — drift_merge_store.dart/profile_program_merger.dart fire merge_row_skipped and outbox_processor.dart fires outbox_dead_lettered (confirmed at outbox_processor.dart:262-272) — but entirely through inline AppLogger/analytics calls that never construct these types. A developer investigating 'why doesn't a merge failure surface a recoverable error to the user' will find MergeException, read its contract, and either burn time hunting for a throw site that doesn't exist or wrongly conclude the safety net is live when it isn't.
recommendation: Either thread these into their designed throw sites (a genuinely-unrecoverable branch in drift_merge_store.dart/profile_program_merger.dart for MergeException; the max-attempts branch in outbox_processor.dart for OutboxDeadLetterException) so `is MergeException` / `is OutboxDeadLetterException` becomes meaningful to callers, or delete both classes, drop the stale W7.2 backlog line in docs/planning/tech-debt-remediation-plan.md:531, and fix the docstrings so they stop describing a control-flow path that doesn't exist.
acceptance_criteria: grep -rn "throw MergeException" learning_tracker/lib returns >=1 hit, or merge_exception.dart is removed and learning_screen_test.dart:80 is updated to use a type that is actually thrown in production
grep -rn "throw OutboxDeadLetterException" learning_tracker/lib returns >=1 hit, or the class is removed
if wired: a new test at test/core/sync/exceptions/ (mirrors lib/core/sync/exceptions/ per AG-5) exercises the real throw site
